Legal.title: Terms and privacy
Legal.intro: Sawwiq showcases the work of social media agencies in Jordan. This page summarises how we use data and what each side is responsible for. The full legal version is under review.
Legal.s1: You don't need an account. We use an anonymous cookie to remember your likes, saves and follows on your device, and to count views once a day. We don't sell your data or use third-party ads.
Legal.s2: When you message an agency, we share your name, number and message with that agency only, with your explicit consent. Messages are kept for 24 months, then deleted.
Legal.s3: You are responsible for the accuracy of your page and for having the right to publish the work you show. Sponsored posts are always labelled "Sponsored". We may hide content that breaks these rules or suspend accounts.
Legal.s4: Under Jordan's Personal Data Protection Law No. 24 of 2023 you can ask to access, correct or delete your data, or withdraw consent. Write to privacy@sawwiq.org.
Legal.s5: Browsing, contacting agencies and asking for quotes are free. On contracts with protected payments, the client pays each milestone to Sawwiq's licensed payment partner, which pays it to the agency when the milestone is accepted. Sawwiq takes 10% of each released payment, deducted from what the agency receives; the client never pays more than the contract amount. Sawwiq never holds client money in its own accounts.
Legal.metaDescription: Sawwiq's terms and privacy: how we use data, your rights under Jordan's Personal Data Protection Law, and what agencies are responsible for.
Legal.s5Test: Browsing, contacting agencies and asking for quotes are free. Protected payments are in test mode: until Sawwiq's licensed payment partner is connected, no real money is collected or held through Sawwiq, the parties pay each other directly, and Sawwiq charges no fee. We will update these terms and tell users before protected payments go live.

About.title: About Sawwiq
About.description: Sawwiq is the Arabic network to find, compare and hire marketing and social media agencies: how we verify agencies and reviews, and how protected payments work.
About.intro: Sawwiq is the Arabic network that brings marketing and social media agencies together in one place: business owners in Jordan, the Gulf and Egypt see their real work, compare prices and client reviews, then contact them directly or contract through the platform with protected payments.

what.title: What we offer
what.body: A page for every agency with its work and priced packages, hire pages for every service and city, an AI assistant that asks about your project and suggests the best-suited agencies with a realistic budget, and project requests where several agencies send you quotes.

verify.title: What our three labels mean
verify.body: "Business identity verified": we checked the agency's commercial registration. It confirms the business is registered, not the quality of its work. "Contact confirmed": the reviewer was invited by the agency with a single-use link or contacted it through Sawwiq, so we know the two were in touch. "Completed-project review": the review comes from a client whose contract on Sawwiq was completed.

reviews.title: How we keep reviews real
reviews.body: Only a client the agency invited with a single-use link, or a client who contacted the agency through Sawwiq, can write a review. Reviews can't be bought and negative ones aren't removed; the agency can reply publicly.

payments.title: Protected payments
payments.body: When you contract through Sawwiq, the work is split into milestones with dates, amounts and a checklist of deliverables. The client pays each milestone to Sawwiq's licensed payment partner, never into Sawwiq's own accounts, and the partner pays the agency only after the milestone is accepted. If the two sides disagree, our team reviews the evidence from both and decides, with one appeal.
payments.bodyTest: When you contract through Sawwiq, the work is split into milestones with dates, amounts and a checklist of deliverables that the client confirms before a milestone is accepted. Protected payments are not live yet: until Sawwiq's licensed payment partner is connected and our legal review is complete, the payment steps run in test mode with no real money, and the two sides pay each other directly. Sawwiq holds no money and charges no fee in the meantime.

demo.title: Demo accounts
demo.body: During the pilot some agencies carry a "Demo" label. They are examples for trying the platform, not real agencies; they are removed as real agencies join and are kept out of search results.

money.title: How Sawwiq makes money
money.body: Browsing, contacting agencies and asking for quotes are free for everyone. On contracts paid through Sawwiq's licensed payment partner, Sawwiq takes 10% of each payment released to the agency; the client never pays more than the contract amount. Later we may offer agencies clearly labelled subscriptions for priority placement; they never change how reviews rank.
money.bodyTest: Browsing, contacting agencies and asking for quotes are free for everyone. Once protected payments go live through a licensed payment partner, Sawwiq will take a fee from each payment released to the agency (planned at 10%), never added to what the client pays. Until then Sawwiq charges no fees. Later we may offer agencies clearly labelled subscriptions for priority placement; they never change how reviews rank.
